test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: C is thrice as good a workman as D and together they can finish a work in 31 days. In how many days will D alone complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

C is thrice as good a workman as D.

C and D together can finish a work in 31 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by C and D together in one day = 1 / Total days to complete the work

Work done by C in one day = 3 × Work done by D in one day

Let work done by D in one day be D₁.<
